reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-FP — resolved sink value is ESAPI.encodeForHTML(filter) written to response.getWriter(), sanitizing the user input contained in filter. Alert 2 (java/ldap-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value is filter = "(&(objectclass=person)(uid=" + bar + "))" where bar originates from request.getParameterValues(user input) and is concatenated directly into the LDAP filter without sanitization. Case TP driven by Alert 2.

evidence.note: User input captured into bar variable from request parameters
LDAP filter constructed by concatenating bar (user input) without sanitization
Filter value is encoded via ESAPI.encodeForHTML before printing to response (mitigates XSS)
